review.summary: Actual final/source sheet and full hero retain the recessed urinal basin, drain, flush sensor and lower outlet with coherent ceramic/metal shading. Fresh FBX/GLB verification passes at 14,182 triangles. No major cavity closure, missing part or new bake defect is visible.

issues.problem: Small sensor-edge simplification and slight fastener softening remain; strong lower-front studio shading is inherited from the source.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet and full hero retain a glossy white ceramic urinal, distinct metallic flush sensor/drain and an open recessed basin. issues.problem: Minor sensor-top irregularity, a narrow side seam and strong studio highlights remain; check that reduction adds no major dents or colour bleeding.
